lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 visible high-contrast vertical white lines are present on the dark grey torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with tighter clustering (approx. 40-60 pixels) on the anterior section and wider intervals (approx. 100-150 pixels) on the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical line from the posterior, splitting at approximately the vertical midpoint of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and fourth lines from the anterior terminate abruptly before reaching the ventral fringe; the most posterior line is visible only as a fragmented dash.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral/lyrate trajectory, diverging laterally from the base before curving medially and terminating in a posterior-superior vector.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-colored tipping occupies the distal 12-15% of the total visible horn arc length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five symbiotic birds (oxpeckers) distributed across the body: one on the posterior tail fringe, one on the mid-lateral torso, one on the right forelimb carpus, one on the left hindlimb, and one on the auricular region.
